import Foundation

let word = try! NSRegularExpression(pattern: "\\w+")

func words(text: String, size: Int, pattern: String) throws -> Bool {
  // ruleid: regex-built-in-function-swift
  let found = try NSRegularExpression(pattern: "a+b")
  let dynamic = try NSRegularExpression(pattern: pattern)
  // ruleid: whole-row-sql-swift
  let query = "SELECT * FROM users"
  let exists = "SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM users)"
  // ruleid: json-column-swift
  let key = "SELECT data->>'k' FROM users"
  // ruleid: bool-array-swift
  let seen = [Bool](repeating: false, count: size)
  // ruleid: in-process-cache-swift
  let cache = NSCache<NSString, NSString>()
  return query.isEmpty && key.isEmpty && exists.isEmpty && found.pattern.isEmpty && dynamic.pattern.isEmpty && seen.isEmpty && cache.name.isEmpty
}

func load(ids: [String], client: Client) async throws {
  for id in ids {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    try await client.get(id)
  }
  for id in ids {
    let found = try await client.has(id)
    if found {
      break
    }
  }
  for id in ids {
    try await client.put(id)
    try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 1_000_000)
  }
  for try await line in client.lines {
    try await client.put(line)
  }
  for try await line in client.stream(
    from: 1
  ) {
    try await client.put(line)
  }
  var cursor = try await client.page("")
  while !cursor.isEmpty {
    cursor = try await client.page(cursor)
  }
}

func pair(client: Client, session: Client, users: Client, orders: Client) async throws -> Int {
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-swift
  let first = try await users.get(1)
  let second = try await orders.get(2)
  let third = try await client.get(second)
  print(third)
  let user = try await session.get(1)
  let org = try await session.get(2)
  print(org)
  // ruleid: sequential-awaits-swift
  let left = try await client.get(1)
  let right = try await client.get(2)
  return first + third + user + org + left + right
}
